name: PayPal - IPN & Webhook di Pagamento
description: Chiamate POST di notifica IPN e Webhook REST inviate dai server PayPal con User-Agent proprietario.
expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and http.user_agent contains "PayPal" and (http.request.uri.path contains "paypal" or http.request.uri.query contains "paypal")
note: Notifiche IPN e webhook PayPal (POST con User-Agent PayPal)
